items.question: How do I start the home buying process?
items.answer: Start by consulting with one of our agents who will assess your requirements, budget, and help you shortlist suitable properties.

items.question: What documents are required for purchasing property?
items.answer: Typically: PAN card, Aadhaar, income proof, bank statements, and property-specific documents. Our team handles all verification.

items.question: Do you assist with home loans?
items.answer: Yes, we have tie-ups with major banks and can help you get pre-approved for a home loan at competitive interest rates.

items.question: What are your brokerage charges?
items.answer: Our brokerage is typically 1-2% of the transaction value, which is competitive in the market. We can discuss this during our initial meeting.
